database.statement_finding: The public read statements showed no comparable multi-second execution hotspot. The delay accumulated at or ahead of API/database admission rather than in one slow table scan.

generator.remaining_uncertainty: Local networking may have contributed to the cross-origin dial failures, but cannot explain Supabase's recorded approximately 12-second origin p95.

scheduled_work.finding: Scheduled database enqueue work was not the primary bottleneck. One downstream scheduled HTTP request still timed out during the load and recovered afterward.

conclusion: The deployed failure includes target-side queueing/saturation on base Micro compute. The dashboard and the original mixed runner multiplied each read action into parallel PostgREST requests; the live dashboard was heavier still. Generator contribution is not fully excluded, so an independent instrumented rerun remains required.

changes: replace the dashboard's approximately eleven concurrent Supabase reads with one SECURITY INVOKER tenant-scoped snapshot RPC
add five indexes used by the snapshot's tenant/time/status predicates
make the BT500 dashboard read action exercise the same snapshot RPC while preserving the approved mix and latency/error thresholds
